newsitem.title: USA: Brookstone stake held by New York group.
newsitem.headline: Brookstone stake held by New York group.

text.p: A group of New York investors said on Tuesday that it has acquired 389,100 common shares of Brookstone Inc., or 5.01 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it acquired the stake for investment purposes.

The group includes investment partnerships EGS Associates L.P., Bev Partners L.P. and Jonas Partners L.P., as well as general partners William Ehrman, Frederic Greenberg, Frederick Ketcher, Jonas Gerstl and James McLaren.
It said it bought 65,000 of its shares between Sept. 24 and Nov. 19 at prices ranging from $9.25 to $10.38 each.
